'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are a forageable item found in most outdoor areas. It does not require any technologies to collect. After unlocking the Insects technology of the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Farming and Nature tech tree]], collecting Red Flowers may also yield {{item|butterfly}} during the day or {{item|moth}} at night.
